title: Refactor code

body.text: improving the code's structure without changing its behavior
— Codex can break up giant functions, reduce duplication, and move to more modern patterns across the whole project.

example: "The handleSubmit function is 200 lines long — break it into readable smaller functions, with exactly the same behavior"

title: Refactor safely

body.text: have tests before refactoring — passing tests both before and after is proof the behavior didn't change
. If there are no tests yet, have Codex write them first, then refactor.

example: "Step 1: write tests covering the current handleSubmit / Step 2: refactor / Step 3: run tests to confirm they all still pass"

options.text: Improving code structure without changing behavior
Cutting code as short as possible regardless of the result

question: What's the proof that a refactor didn't change behavior?

options.text: Tests pass both before and after the refactor
The AI says it didn't change

question: If the code to refactor has no tests, what should you do?

options.text: Refactor right away and risk it
